items.title: Müller teams up on yogurt NPD with Mondelez, Pladis
items.summary: The companies are launching Müller Corner SKUs with Oreo, Jaffa Cakes and Flipz in singles this week.

items.title: Food giants face Poland ‘shrinkflation’ scrutiny
items.summary: The regulator said the review covers food, cleaning and personal care products sold on the Polish market.

items.title: Mondelēz shifts European biscuit packaging from plastic trays to paper
items.summary: The switch applies to more than 115 products sold under eight brands. These include Cadbury, Chips Ahoy!, Freia, Lacta and Marabou.

items.title: Cramer Says the Snack Business Is Bad. Mondelez and Smucker Did Not Get the Message.
items.summary: Jim Cramer called Campbell's snack quarter a nightmare and warned the whole category is broken, but two other packaged food giants reported something very different this week and raised their dividends to prove it.

items.title: Mondelēz is scaling up its sports marketing by going more regional
items.summary: The company, which owns multiple snack brands, recently announced partnerships with the Kansas City Chiefs and five NCAA programs.

items.title: Mondelez International Stock: Is MDLZ Underperforming the Consumer Staples Sector?
items.summary: Mondelez has underperformed the broader consumer staples sector over the past year, but improving volumes, stronger margins, and resilient demand have kept analysts cautiously bullish on the stock’s outlook.

items.title: Mondelēz, PepsiCo and pladis join forces for circular packaging trial
items.summary: The exercise will measure how the watermarking system works on wrappers, films and other plastic food packs.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell MDLZ and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Mondelez currently trades at $62.11 per share and has shown little upside over the past six months, posting a middling return of 2.8%. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 12.1% gain during that period.
